pages.title: Overview
pages.text: Early game progression is dominated by exploring and looting. The world is full of magic loot, especially in new magic structures that can be found dotted across the lands. But be careful! Each magic structure is home to a powerful mage, who will not take kindly to you.

pages.title: Scrolls
pages.text: Scrolls will be your first taste of magic. While they can be consumed to cast the spell they hold, it is better to save them until you can inscribe it into a spell book, where it can be used repeatedly, via an Inscription Table >>>

pages.title: Inscription Table
pages.text: In order to properly use a Spell Book, you must inscribe spells into it with the Inscription Table by using scrolls. Scrolls can be retrieved once put into a Spell Book, but it will uninscribe the spell. Beginner spell books can be crafted with basic materials.

pages.title: Basic Materials
pages.text: Some basic materials can even be found sparsely in vanilla structures.$(br2)Arcane Essence can be combined with leather armor to craft Wandering Magician armor, an early source of additional max mana.

The most common of the inks (ergo the name), common ink can craft the lowest level of spells. If a spell's lowest level is above common, it cannot be crafted with common ink. The same goes for all other inks.
Less common than common, it can craft slightly more powerful spells.
The rare ink should be able to be found regularly in magic treasure chests or by killing spellcasting mobs.
The best place for epic ink and all other high rarity inks is from magic treasure or killing spellcasting mobs.
The most rare ink, it will craft the most powerful spells. Keep in mind, some spells have multiple legendary levels, requiring use of the Arcane Anvil to obtain them.

pages.title: Arcane Anvil
pages.text: Late game is reached by obtaining netherite and vast quantities of basic resources, and powered by the Arcane Anvil.$(br2)The Arcane Anvil is the most powerful crafting station, used to level up your scrolls, upgrade armor and spell books, and imbue weapons with spells.

pages.title: More Spell Books
pages.text: The best craftable spell books are shown here. The ruined book is found in Ancient Cities
Dragonskin is dropped by the Ender Dragon
School armor is made from arcane cloth and a particular school rune, following this template

pages.title: Upgrading
pages.text: Upgrades are the final form of progression. By default, any armor as well as spell books can be upgraded.$(br2)Upgrade orbs of a specific attribute are made from a base upgrade orb, and 8 runes of the desired attribute.
Mithril is a rare Overworld ore, found below y = -38 and unexposed to air. It requires a netherite pickaxe.
Cinder Essence is dropped from Ancient Knights, which can be awakened by breaking armor piles in the nether.

pages.title: Scroll Forge
pages.text: Upon reaching nether level resources, you will unlock an entirely new dynamic to gaining power: The Scroll Forge$(br2)The Scroll Forge is used to craft scrolls by using ink, paper, and a focus. The ink determines the rarity (and therefore level), and the focus determines spell's school.

pages.title: New Spell Books
pages.text: Furthermore, intermediate spell books can be crafted using nether resources
Hogskin is dropped by Hoglins

pages.title: New Materials
pages.text: You should also start to craft stronger armor using arcane cloth. In order to get high quantities of arcane essence, you will need to focus on raiding magical structures.

pages.title: Rare Materials
pages.text: In order to continue progressing, keep an eye out for runestones in magical structures. Runestones are used to craft even more powerful armor. Class mages always drop a rune of their school.

pages.title: Overview
pages.text: Each magical spell belong to a school of magic. Each school encapsulates a theme, both visually and functionally, and each have a Focus: a representative item used as a crafting ingredient. Furthermore, each school can be empowered by specific school related gear, allowing you to become a powerful master of a single school, or mix and match to become a jack of all trades.

pages.title: Fire
pages.text: The Fire school, with a Blaze Rod as its Focus, is centered around damage and damage over time.

pages.title: Ice
pages.text: The Ice school, with Frozen Bones as its Focus, is centered around damage and crowd control.

pages.title: Lightning
pages.text: The Lightning school, with a Bottle o' Lightning as its Focus, is centered around concentrated damage.

pages.title: Holy
pages.text: The Holy school, with the Divine Pearl as its Focus, is centered around support, healing, and buffing allies.

pages.title: Ender
pages.text: The Ender school, with an Ender Pearl as its Focus, is themed around all things arcane and mystical, with spells that range from damage to utility to mobility.

pages.title: Blood
pages.text: The Blood school, with a Blood Vial as its Focus, is themed around evil; you will find elements of necromancy, wither, and blood magic here, with spells focusing on damage that buffs the caster.

pages.title: Evocation
pages.text: The Evocation school, with an Emerald as its Focus, is themed around magical trickery and conjuration, covering the broadest range of offensive, defensive, and utility spells.

pages.title: Nature
pages.text: The Nature school, with a Poisonous Potato as its Focus, is focused on applying debuffs to enemies, with elements of damage to finish them off.

pages.title: Eldritch
pages.text: The Eldritch school is not like the others. It is an ancient and powerful way of magic, one that has all but been forgotten; you will be unable to immediately craft or cast Eldritch spells. However, shreds of ancient Eldritch manuscripts can still be found scattered throughout the world, and may even be pieced back together with the help of an echo shard.

pages.title: Eldritch, continued
pages.text: Once a manuscript has been restored, it can be consumed to learn a single Eldritch spell, enabling the crafting and casting of it. After being learned, the Echo Shard is used as the focus.

pages.title: Casting Implements
pages.text: Casting Implements are items that can be right-clicked (used) in order to cast your active spell. Most often, they also provide passive benefits, allowing for a dedicated wizard playstyle.
A simple stick is all it takes to get the crystal ball rolling.
Sometimes, additional style is all it takes to bring your casting to the next level.
Pieces of a mystical frosted staff are rumored to lie about the overworld. The Cryomancer may have research stowed away in his tower revealing more.
An ancient scepter with unmatched summoning abilities, it can only be acquired by taking it from its undead owner.

pages.title: Craftable Spell Books
pages.text: Many spell Books can be crafted from a combination of vanilla and arcane materials. Each further tier crafted increases the slot count of the spell book and often comes with extra bonuses, increasing the power and quantity of spells it can contain.

pages.title: Named Spell Books
pages.text: Named spell books can be found nestled in many corners of the world, often offering bonuses to lucky adventurers looking in the right places.

What may have once been a more powerful book has since rotted away, leaving but three pages. Yet, still more powerful than most Overworld spell books. They can be looted from equally rotten places all across the Overworld.

A regular book with a little blessing makes a suitable channel for divine magic. Building a reputation with the villagers, especially by freeing captives from the Archevoker, will ensure one falls into your hands eventually.
Every Blaze, unbeknownst to them, comes with one of these tucked away. The trick is killing them and hoping it doesn't turn into ash.
A strong magical energy still persists within the Rotten Spell Book. The book may be blessed anew if a proper remedy were applied.

pages.title: Scrolls
pages.text: Scrolls can be found in chests, looted from mobs, or crafted. Each Scroll contains a spell with a level, similar to an enchanted book. Scrolls can be upgraded in the Arcane Anvil by combining them with the corresponding rarity of ink of their next level.

Scrolls can be used on their own to cast their spell, subverting mana costs and cooldown, but consuming the scroll in the process. Primarily, they are inscribed into spell books for continued use, or recycled via the Alchemist Cauldron to be turned into more useful spells.

pages.title: Unique Spell Books
pages.text: Unique spell books are rare drops from certain mobs that come with spells inscribed, which cannot be removed or edited. Not every spell book can be manufactured -- it is called the arcane art, after all.

pages.title: Unique Improvements
pages.text: The spells in a unique spell book are locked, but can be improved. By combining a unique spell book in the Arcane Anvil with a higher-level scroll of the same spell from the spell book, you can raise the level of the locked spell.
A book full of foundational illager magick, the Grimoire of Evokation can be dropped by Evokers or their more powerful casting cousin, Archevokers.
An ancient book holding a host of dark spells, it can only be acquired by taking it from its undead owner.

names.item.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log.pag: We arrived at the location He sent us to just before last dusk, a march of many days. One last time, we slept on the dirt; this morning we rose with purpose anew, beginning to etch a barrier of logs and home of stone.
Construction is near complete. As I write, supplies make their way into our hospice - freshly hewn wood from the area, a shipment of glass from fort greater. Discovery awaits.

I had never thought it possible, this magic seems to be messing with my mind. I swear there used to be a cellar below the chapel, yet even my second in command says it were never so... Surely I cannot be the one going mad?

Scouts have returned with fantastic news, that of a village, and not too far to return the supplies here with ease after laying siege. However, magical research in this area seems to be inconclusive. We may be abandoning soon.
names.item.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log.ent: We reached the location to which He bade us journey, a laborious march spanning many days. As the sun surrendered to dusk, we rested our wearied bodies upon the earth for what I trust to be the final time. This morn,
we rose with purpose anew, and began to etch a barrier of logs and home of stone.

Our construction draws nigh its completion. As I pen these very words, the final shipment of supplies flow into our haven - enough timber, freshly hewn from the surrounding wilds, to finish the enclosure, and panes of glass
sent from Fort Greater. Soon shall the research commence, the likes of which may yet shake the pillars of the world.

A strange unease takes root within my mind. This magic - though wondrous - doth twist the senses. I could have sworn there was a cellar beneath the chapel's floor, and yet now none recall it. Even my most trusted lieutenant
claims such a thing never was. Am I alone in this delusion? Has madness begun to gnaw at me?
Our scouts return with tidings of a village, not far from our encampment. This is good news, for supplies dwindle. We shall lay siege and easily procure what is needed, for the distance is not great.
However, the magical research in these lands proves troublesome - few are the answers we seek. It may soon come to pass that we abandon this place, move to the next site.
